entry_points.description: Deterministic synthetic GPT-2 CPU forward/backward training slice, representative of train_gpt2.c C reference kernels without pretrained weights.
entry_points.inputs: Training workload: B=2, T=32, C=64, NH=4, L=2, V=512, Vp=512, 5 repeated forward/backward passes; deterministic xorshift synthetic parameters and token ids.
entry_points.setup: Harness constructs model parameters and token batches deterministically in memory; no checkpoint or dataset download is required.
entry_points.limitations: Standalone synthetic CPU slice; it excludes file I/O, tokenizer/dataloader, AdamW update, and real pretrained weights. It is intended to exercise forward/backward kernels in train_gpt2.c.

entry_points.description: Held-out deterministic synthetic CPU forward/backward slice with longer sequence length and one layer.
entry_points.inputs: Held-out validation: B=1, T=40, C=64, NH=4, L=1, V=384, Vp=384, 4 repeated forward/backward passes; not used as the default search workload.
entry_points.setup: Harness constructs model parameters and token batches deterministically in memory.
entry_points.limitations: Synthetic validation slice; no file I/O, update step, or pretrained weights.

entry_points.description: Held-out deterministic synthetic CPU forward/backward slice with wider channels and different head count.
entry_points.inputs: Held-out validation: B=1, T=24, C=96, NH=6, L=2, V=512, Vp=512, 3 repeated forward/backward passes; not used as the default search workload.
entry_points.setup: Harness constructs model parameters and token batches deterministically in memory.
entry_points.limitations: Synthetic validation slice; no file I/O, update step, or pretrained weights.

description: CPU-only synthetic GPT-2 forward/backward benchmark for train_gpt2.c reference kernels. Uses deterministic generated inputs to avoid pretrained-weight downloads and includes separate held-out entry points with different shapes.
